name: orchard
description: Connects a session to an Orchard workspace through the packaged Orchard agent CLI: resumes or joins on start, listens for alerts and wakes an idle session on the messages that matter (notification levels, batching, a minimum gap), carries the rest with the next prompt, acknowledges only after delivery, shows a band above the prompt when there is news, offers the model orchard_send, orchard_reply, orchard_ack, orchard_history and orchard_call, opens an /orchard pane (Claude's inbox with a selection and one toolbar for remove, snooze, handle-next and interrupt, decisions waiting on the owner, claimed tasks, notification settings), and goes offline and retries when the workspace is unreachable. Workspace content reaches the model framed as data, and the credential never enters model context

endpoint.title: Workspace endpoint
endpoint.description: Loopback MCP URL of the Orchard workspace (http://127.0.0.1:PORT/workspaces/ID/mcp). Empty: the mod does nothing

credentialFile.title: Credential file
credentialFile.description: Absolute path of the workspace credential file. Only the path is used: it is handed to the Orchard CLI in its environment and the mod never reads the file

participantId.title: Participant id
participantId.description: Stable identity in the workspace (letters, digits, . _ -). Empty: claude-<name of the session's folder>

name.title: Display name
name.description: Name shown to the workspace when joining. Empty: Claude (<name of the session's folder>)

orchardBin.title: Orchard executable
orchardBin.description: The Orchard binary whose `agent` command is run
